# Inactive workflow examples

These are the generator's original GitHub Actions workflows, preserved as examples. They are not active and no npm publishing is configured.

The GitHub login used for this submission can publish repository code but does not have the workflow permission needed to upload active Actions files. All reported verification ran locally. No additional account permission was requested.

Regeneration can recreate `.github/workflows/`. Review those files before enabling them. In particular, the publishing workflow needs separate maintainer configuration and must not be enabled merely to run SDK tests.
